description: A worker resource on a live stack: scaffold with flisk resource --type worker, flisk up, the worker is listed as a worker in flisk status, its container logged its start line, flisk restart starts the same container again without rebuilding the image, one error envelope when Tilt is unreachable, and the container processed the demo job the scaffold hands out (openspec task 3.6, #1290; #1294; #4192).
